text: This pair finds out where it is headed by setting off. Composite Mars sits on the composite North Node, so what the relationship goes after and the ground it has not covered are a single function, and there is no way to consult the second without engaging the first. Talk yields very little here. Two people can spend a year discussing what this connection might become and learn less than they learn in the first fortnight of trying it. Direction is not available to this bond in advance. It turns up in the middle of an effort, usually as a surprise, and often as something neither of you would have chosen off a list. That gives the relationship real initiative, along with a faint sense of not recognizing itself. What these two go after together tends to be what neither goes after alone. Appetite is a joint product in this bond, and it can feel borrowed to both people, which is part of why the pair keeps checking whether it is being sensible. Disagreement does the same work. Assertion and development are one body here, so a conversation in which somebody finally states a want changes the relationship more than a month of easy agreement does, and both people tend to notice the change well after it happened. The catch is that a want arrives pre-approved. When drive and direction are the same thing, this bond has no instrument for asking whether a particular appetite leads anywhere, because from the inside every push reads as the road. Considerable force can go into whatever turned up first, at the pitch that belonged to something else entirely. The geometry does not sort one from the other and was never going to. What it does supply is a relationship that never has to be argued into moving. Whatever these two learn about where this is going, they learn with their coats on.

Beginning something is cheap for this relationship. Composite Mars sextiles the composite North Node, which keeps the pair's drive within short reach of ground it has not covered, near enough that a first step needs no occasion to justify it. In practice that produces one uncommon knack. This bond can want something on purpose. Most relationships wait until they feel like it, and the feeling comes on its own schedule or fails to come at all. These two can decide a direction is worth trying and then supply enough appetite to start, with nobody having to be inspired first. Manufactured enthusiasm is usually thin stuff. Here it holds long enough to get the thing moving. The same access shows in how a want gets raised. A preference can go on the table as a proposal rather than as a grievance that has been kept for months, so the unfamiliar option often gets discussed while it is still small and still optional. Very little is at stake in those conversations, which is why they happen at all. The two of you are not required to be certain, or ready, or especially moved, before a direction can be tried on. None of it is required. A sextile offers, and this relationship can run for long stretches on business it already knows how to conduct, with the route sitting there unbothered. A subtler failure comes from the ease rather than from neglect. Since a modest push is always to hand, new ground gets taken in modest installments, and installments are comfortable. The pair starts, gets a fair way in, then starts somewhere else, and over time the relationship collects a wide assortment of things it has begun and no experience of what happens when its whole weight goes behind one of them. Where the contact pays, it pays in a low threshold. A bond that can begin without an occasion gets to learn what a road is like from the inside, and no amount of weighing it up from here produces that.

How this pair pushes is precisely what its new ground will not take. Composite Mars squares the composite North Node, and the two force each other: the relationship's practiced way of going after things is the wrong tool for the direction that would develop it, and that way is the one it reaches for. The collision does not settle. It turns up wherever these two attempt something they have no practice at, which is the same territory the node marks. Most often it looks like a dispute about pace. An unfamiliar plan gets started and within a week the subject has changed to whether it is being rushed, or stalled, or handled by the wrong person in the wrong order. That argument is honestly about method, which is what makes it so absorbing. The plan waits where it was left. A quieter version is more common. The bond meets resistance on the new road and answers with more effort, because effort has answered everything else, and this particular road does not respond to effort. It asks for patience, or an approach nobody has tried, or a willingness to be a beginner in public. So the pair applies force, gets nowhere, and concludes the direction was a mistake. Readers arrive at a square like this wanting to know whether the relationship comes through its own friction. A midpoint chart holds no view on that. It reports nothing about duration under any aspect, and a square in particular marks where a bond makes resistance, not what becomes of it. The traction is specific. This relationship cannot reach its own new ground on first instinct, so across years it is obliged to build a second way of wanting: slower, less certain, much less satisfying to use. Pairs with easier contacts here never build one. Both of you are likely to read the stall as a sign the bond is wrong about itself, some while before it turns out to be the schooling this angle was always going to hand over.

New ground does not feel like new ground here. Composite Mars trines the composite North Node, so the drive of this relationship and the direction it develops in run together with nothing between them, and the pair steps onto unfamiliar territory in roughly the mood it does everything else. A proposal that would make another bond hesitate gets taken up in the ordinary way. Appetite is already pointed where the growth is. No case has to be made, and courage never comes into it, since courage is what a reluctant relationship needs and this one is not reluctant. Comfortable growth is not a small gift. What the ease removes is the education. Difficulty teaches a bond what it actually wants, because a want that costs something has to be looked at before it gets paid for, and here nothing costs enough to be looked at. The relationship goes at the new thing, enjoys it, and comes away with the experience but not with the self-knowledge a harder passage would have handed over. A second gap shows up later. This bond has never had to insist on anything, so it has no practice at carrying on once the appetite has gone. Initiative it has in quantity. Persistence is a separate faculty, and an easy angle supplies no occasion to develop it, which is how a pair with this contact ends up with a long record of excellent beginnings and a thin one of finished business. Nothing corrects that from the inside. There is no stall, no objection, and so no afternoon on which either of you is asked what the direction was for. What the two functions do give this relationship is mobility. It can change what it is doing without a crisis and aim itself at something strange without a rehearsal, and it is usually further along than more careful pairs by the time anybody thinks to compare.

What this relationship wants and where it would develop are rarely the same object. Composite Mars stands opposite the composite North Node, appetite at one end of an axis and unfamiliar ground at the other, and the bond is asked for both together. Whatever these two are fired up about is generally something the relationship already knows how to do, done once more with real energy behind it. The direction that would take the bond somewhere it has not been is generally a thing nobody wants yet, and it sits in plain view, obviously sensible and thoroughly unappealing. So the seasons trade off. A stretch of hard pursuit ends up roughly where it started, and then comes a clear-eyed stretch in which the pair can name exactly what it ought to be attempting and cannot raise the appetite to attempt it. Energy and direction take turns being available. The two are seldom in the room in the same month, and that is the ordinary condition of this axis rather than a run of bad luck. As with any opposition, the ends get parcelled out between two people, and whoever is currently making the case for the sensible road was making the other case not long ago. Held together, this works out untidily. Pairs who get somewhere on this axis tend to go at the unfamiliar thing carrying enthusiasm that was generated by something else, borrowed and a size or two off, and the borrowing is enough. Desire does not have to be correctly aimed to be useful. It has to be present. Nothing in the figure reports how well a given bond manages that trade. The stretch between the poles is not damage. It is what a relationship feels like while it is being asked to want something the pair of you have not learned to want yet.
